exact_claim: Remembers everything.
evidence_required: No realistic evidence can prove universal memory across deletions, limits, outages, unsupported facts, provider failures, and all future time.
required_qualification_or_replacement: Do not publish. Replace with a scoped claim such as ‘Keeps confirmed story facts across this saved game’ only after evidence exists.
counsel_note: Explicitly prohibited by founder brief.

exact_claim: Never forgets your choices.
evidence_required: Would require zero-loss evidence across all choices, games, account states, incidents, and retention limits.
required_qualification_or_replacement: Do not publish. Use a scoped continuity claim tied to saved games and supported facts.
counsel_note: Absolute likely conflicts with disclosed limits.

exact_claim: Never loses your place.
evidence_required: Backup/restore tests; save semantics; anonymous-session behaviour; outage and deletion handling; measured loss rate.
required_qualification_or_replacement: Prefer ‘Restores the last completed saved moment’ with stated account/save conditions.
counsel_note: Avoid absolute wording.

exact_claim: Remembers your choices.
evidence_required: Choice-persistence tests across reload, return, cancellation, repair, and supported retention period.
required_qualification_or_replacement: Scope to ‘confirmed choices in this saved game’ and link to limitations.
counsel_note: Objective capability claim requires documentation.

exact_claim: Keeps confirmed story facts across this saved game.
evidence_required: Snapshot and restore test suite covering protected facts and save boundaries.
required_qualification_or_replacement: State any expiry, account, deletion, or unsupported-data limits near the claim.
counsel_note: More supportable than universal memory.

exact_claim: Continuity-checked before the story moves on.
evidence_required: Coverage map of shipped hard gates; test results; false-positive/negative samples; failure handling.
required_qualification_or_replacement: Clarify the categories checked; do not imply human review or universal factual accuracy.
counsel_note: Qualification must not contradict the headline.

exact_claim: Repairs unsupported details without changing your valid choice.
evidence_required: Repair tests showing narrow rewrite, preserved action, restored state, and correction confirmation.
required_qualification_or_replacement: Use only for covered claim patterns and disclose exceptions.
counsel_note: Do not claim all contradictions are repaired.

exact_claim: No invented items.
evidence_required: Would require perfect prevention across all prompts and outputs.
required_qualification_or_replacement: Replace with ‘Checks carried-item claims against the current snapshot’ if evidenced.
counsel_note: Absolute performance claim.

exact_claim: Checks carried-item claims against the current snapshot.
evidence_required: Object-in-hand and last-item hard-gate tests plus adversarial near-misses.
required_qualification_or_replacement: Name only the checks actually shipped.
counsel_note: Tightly scoped operational claim.

exact_claim: Only present speakers can answer.
evidence_required: Named-speaker-absence and location-as-speaker tests; legitimate quotation/voice exceptions.
required_qualification_or_replacement: Qualify for ordinary in-scene dialogue and supported remote communication.
counsel_note: Avoid overbroad statement if telepathy, radio, recordings, or narration exist.

exact_claim: Your failed turn is returned.
evidence_status: EVIDENCED founder rule; INPUT REQUIRED implementation
evidence_required: Production test that no-result failures restore cap and prior completed state; define usable partial output.
required_qualification_or_replacement: Use exact operational definition of failed turn.
counsel_note: Player cap refund is separate from provider cost.

exact_claim: Opening setup does not use a story turn.
evidence_status: EVIDENCED founder rule; INPUT REQUIRED counter
evidence_required: Counter tests around New Game and refresh; prevent duplicate setup charges.
required_qualification_or_replacement: Say ‘story turn’ rather than ‘free call’; provider inference may still bill the service.
counsel_note: Clear player-facing scope.

exact_claim: A new game includes eight extra text turns once.
evidence_status: EVIDENCED founder rule; INPUT REQUIRED eligibility
evidence_required: Durable one-time flag tests; exact expiry and restart rules.
required_qualification_or_replacement: State whether the bonus expires and what counts as a new game.
counsel_note: Avoid dark patterns encouraging repeated restarts.

exact_claim: The Free path usually includes about 12 story turns a day.
evidence_status: EVIDENCED founder target; INPUT REQUIRED configuration
evidence_required: Authoritative cap config; reset timezone; exceptions; incident behaviour.
required_qualification_or_replacement: Use ‘about’ until exact enforcement and reset rules are confirmed.
counsel_note: Do not display an exact promise if operations vary.

exact_claim: Memorable images are off by default.
evidence_status: EVIDENCED founder rule; INPUT REQUIRED production proof
evidence_required: Configuration and network tests showing no automatic image request.
required_qualification_or_replacement: Keep the default visible and require explicit eligible action.
counsel_note: Good trust claim if technically enforced.

exact_claim: The Free path includes no weekly memorable image.
evidence_status: EVIDENCED founder rule; INPUT REQUIRED configuration
evidence_required: Plan-entitlement snapshot and billing tests.
required_qualification_or_replacement: Display as ‘0/week’ or equivalent without implying paid eligibility.
counsel_note: Material plan term.

exact_claim: Ads are optional overflow only.
evidence_status: EVIDENCED founder policy; INPUT REQUIRED SDK/UX proof
evidence_required: Base allowance tests; refusal path; no forced interstitials; privacy/consent review.
required_qualification_or_replacement: State the extra-turn amount and data implications before consent.
counsel_note: Must remain optional in substance, not just wording.

exact_claim: Ads never appear in Kid Mode.
evidence_status: EVIDENCED founder policy; INPUT REQUIRED technical proof
evidence_required: Tests showing SDK never loads/calls, no ad UI, no identifiers, and no reward endpoint in Kid Mode.
required_qualification_or_replacement: Do not publish until network and build-level evidence exists.
review_trigger: Ad SDK or Kid gate change
counsel_note: A public safety claim needs strong evidence.

exact_claim: Ads never interrupt a story action.
evidence_status: EVIDENCED founder policy; INPUT REQUIRED UX proof
evidence_required: End-to-end tests across all ad entry points and reconnect/failure paths.
required_qualification_or_replacement: Specify ‘story action’ consistently.
counsel_note: Avoid an interstitial before the result.

exact_claim: Kid Mode is safe for children.
evidence_required: No absolute safety proof across all ages, prompts, model failures, external links, and jurisdictions.
required_qualification_or_replacement: Replace with factual controls: ‘Kid Mode removes adult prompt rows and disables ads’ only if evidenced.
counsel_note: Avoid universal ‘safe’ claims.

exact_claim: Kid Mode removes adult prompt rows and softens repair copy.
evidence_required: Bank routing tests; content classifications; no adult-row leakage; regression suite.
required_qualification_or_replacement: List the controls actually enforced and disclose that generated content can still fail.
review_trigger: Prompt bank or mode routing change
counsel_note: Operational, not absolute, wording.

exact_claim: Your story is private.
evidence_required: Complete processor/logging/support/training/public-sharing map.
required_qualification_or_replacement: Prefer ‘Not public by default’ if true; explain processors and lawful access.
review_trigger: Any processor, logging, or sharing change
counsel_note: ‘Private’ can imply no third-party processing.

exact_claim: Your story is not public by default.
evidence_required: Feature audit confirming no gallery/share/public URL by default and access-control tests.
required_qualification_or_replacement: Disclose processors and any deliberate sharing action.
counsel_note: Requires re-review before any public feature.

exact_claim: We do not train on your story.
evidence_required: SynapticGM practice; OpenRouter and underlying-provider terms/settings; analytics/support use.
required_qualification_or_replacement: Do not publish until every recipient and route is covered; qualify any evaluation use.
counsel_note: Pricing pages do not establish training terms.

exact_claim: Delete your account and all data disappears instantly.
evidence_required: Deletion runbook; backup lag; payment/tax/security/legal retention exceptions.
required_qualification_or_replacement: Use a timed, accurate deletion statement with listed exceptions.
counsel_note: Instant/all-data wording is rarely supportable.

exact_claim: You can request deletion of your account and saved stories.
evidence_required: Verified request flow, identity checks, processor propagation, backup treatment, completion notice.
required_qualification_or_replacement: State timing and lawful retention exceptions.
counsel_note: Operational promise must be tested.

exact_claim: Free means £0 for the included allowance.
evidence_status: EVIDENCED founder price; INPUT REQUIRED checkout/SDK proof
evidence_required: No required payment, forced ad, or mandatory purchase; exact included allowance disclosed.
required_qualification_or_replacement: Do not imply unlimited use or zero data processing.
counsel_note: ‘Free’ must not hide material conditions.

exact_claim: Mid is £14.99 and High is £29.99.
evidence_status: EVIDENCED founder price; INPUT REQUIRED tax/term
evidence_required: VAT display, billing period, renewal, cancellation, territory, and supplier-of-record decisions.
required_qualification_or_replacement: Show billing period and VAT-inclusive total where required.
counsel_note: Quoted consumer prices require material information.

exact_claim: Free uses DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731; Mid uses Claude Haiku 4.5; High uses Claude Sonnet 4.6.
evidence_status: PUBLICLY EVIDENCED IDs/prices; INPUT REQUIRED live routing
evidence_required: Production route logs; provider/trademark terms; fallback policy; deprecation plan.
required_qualification_or_replacement: Date the statement and disclose whether fallback can use another model.
counsel_note: Third-party model names and availability can change.

exact_claim: Commercial-safe asset pack.
evidence_status: PUBLICLY EVIDENCED licences; INPUT REQUIRED exact shipped files
evidence_required: Source URL, licence, retrieval date, file hash, notices, trademark/privacy/model-release review, and exact shipped version.
required_qualification_or_replacement: Do not market as infringement-proof; use ‘license-reviewed asset sources’ internally.
counsel_note: CC0/MIT do not eliminate all rights risks.

exact_claim: Original SynapticGM visual prompts.
evidence_status: ORIGINAL pack; INPUT REQUIRED generation review
evidence_required: Prompt scan; banned-term scan; output similarity, logo, signature, and provenance review.
required_qualification_or_replacement: Claim originality of the prompt text, not guaranteed uniqueness or non-infringement of every output.
counsel_note: Distinguish prompt authorship from output rights.

exact_claim: The best AI game master.
evidence_required: Defined comparison set, current objective test, methodology, material metric, and reproducible result.
required_qualification_or_replacement: Use non-comparative product facts instead.
counsel_note: Unqualified superlative may be treated as a comparative claim.

exact_claim: No hallucinations.
evidence_required: Impossible to establish zero unsupported output across all use.
required_qualification_or_replacement: Use scoped hard-gate claims with coverage and limitations.
counsel_note: Avoid model jargon in player-facing copy as well as absolute claim.

exact_claim: Corrections are explained in ordinary story language.
evidence_status: ORIGINAL copy bank; INPUT REQUIRED UI tests
evidence_required: Screenshots and tests proving no model, retrieval, transaction, regex, or validation jargon leaks.
required_qualification_or_replacement: Scope to correction surfaces.
counsel_note: Supportable experience claim.

exact_claim: Declined skill offers stay declined.
evidence_status: ORIGINAL product rule; INPUT REQUIRED state tests
evidence_required: Persistence tests across reload, new turns, retries, and materially new deeds.
required_qualification_or_replacement: Clarify that a different deed may create a separate offer.
counsel_note: Player-agency claim.
